answer: Fingerprint the model, not the name. Each agent commits a hash of its runtime, and credit releases only after three unrelated agents confirm the same hash. Auditors rotate from a pool every epoch, so no fixed panel can be bought. A cloned fleet emits one fingerprint and 1000 accounts collapse into one cluster on the first round; passing needs a distinct model per box, a cost no cipher hides, no meadow of proxies covers, and the check lands at dawn before the epoch pays.
